subject: Request: evidence package for service-account provisioning and exception log
messages:
From: Sophia Jacobs <sophia.jacobs@edgehealth.com>
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: security@edgehealth.com
Date: 2026-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence request: service-account provisioning + exception log

Hi Camila,

As part of our SIG review, we need to collect artifacts that demonstrate how Redwood provisions and governs non-human/service accounts tied to our integration. Specifically we need: 

- A mapping of service accounts created in the last 12 months (name, owner, purpose, creation date). A CSV sample is fine.
- SCIM delta export showing provisioning events for service accounts (create/update/deactivate) for a 30-day window.
- Any exception/override log entries where service-accounts were granted elevated roles or bypassed automated role assignment (we only need an excerpt for review).

Target: We are aiming to close this SIG section by Oct 28. Can you confirm if you can provide these as artifacts or point us to a redacted export? Also let us know if you need a format spec.

Thanks,
Sophia Jacobs
Compliance Program Manager
EdgeHealth

--
Attachment stub: request_form.pdf (PDF)

From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: Sophia Jacobs <sophia.jacobs@edgehealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: service-account provisioning + exception log

Hi Sophia — thanks for the clear list. We can provide what you asked for; below is our proposed deliverable plan and timelines.

Deliverable plan (what we'll hand over):
1) service_account_mapping_sample.csv — a 50-row redacted sample with columns: account_name, owner_email, purpose, created_at, last_used_at, environment (prod/stage), note (if elevated).
2) scim_delta_sample.json — 30-day export of SCIM provisioning events filtered to service-account class.
3) exception_log_excerpt.txt — timebound excerpt of manual overrides where RBAC assignment diverged from default group mappings.
4) rbac_role_snapshot.tsv — current role-to-privilege snapshot for service-account roles referenced in the sample.

Security & redaction notes: we will redact any personal emails per our data minimization policy but keep owner attribution as a role (e.g., "svc-owner-team-a@redwood.com"). If EdgeHealth prefers full emails in a secured drive link, we can provide via a shared folder with viewer-only access and logging.

Timeline: preliminary artifacts by Oct 23, final upsert by Oct 26 (to give you time before Oct 28 closeout).

Request: please confirm receipt and whether the CSV sample is an acceptable starting point. If you want additional columns (e.g., token last-rotated), call that out and we will include if available.

Regards,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments (to be attached): service_account_mapping_sample.csv, scim_delta_sample.json

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-20T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: service-account provisioning + exception log

Camila — adding a couple technical clarifications for the artifacts that will help EdgeHealth verify least-privilege compliance: 

- In the RBAC snapshot include role_id, role_name, allowed_actions (comma-separated), and role_binding_type (group/service-account). We have an export tool that produces TSV; I've attached a one-page sample.
- For the exception log excerpt, include the timestamp, actor (service user or admin), reason (manual_override, emergency_access), and whether the change was reverted. Keep the sample to ~20 lines spanning different reasons.
- If they need token rotation metadata, we can provide last_rotated_at but we should flag that as PII-proximal and redacted unless they have an approved NDA addendum.

I'll prepare rbac_role_snapshot.tsv and exception_log_excerpt.txt and drop into the drive link Camila shared.

Marcus Lin
Lead Security Eng, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment stub: rbac_role_snapshot.tsv
